programmes.d: Three orphaned children continue their parents' quest for gold.
A goat and some biscuits save a family from death.
A Mormon leader is determined to enforce God's law with a gun.
A physician courts disaster by aiding one of two feuding Natives.
After a trip to town, two miners find gold nuggets mixed with beans they bought.
A peace-seeking Native scout aids pioneers besieged by Native renegades.
A trouble-shooter must establish a mail route in bandit country.
A young man hunts for gold, hoping to impress his girl so she'll accept his proposal.
A woman flirts with a ranch hand while waiting for a proposal from her beau despite her grandma's warning.
Wagon master Caleb must bring his wayward son Johnny to justice after the boy goes too far.
This tale of misadventure focuses on Frank Baum's penning of 'The Wonderful Wizard of Oz.'
Maso and Okei, tea growers in Gold Hills, encounter both friendship and racism from the locals.
Postal inspector Wesley Hull is determined to discover how postmaster Reardon can sell so many stamps.
Natives reject the doctrines of Christianity in this biographical tale of missionary priest Jean Baptiste Lamy.
There's more than gold in store for prim Wilhelmina Vail when she tackles a claim in rugged Utah territory.
A cowboy and a Native man join forces to secure dowries for their sweethearts.
A sheriff schemes to win an interest in California's wine industry.
A loveless woman baker decides to leave, causing her town to lose its only pie supplier.
Father de la Cuesta is curious why a deceased padre ordered a hand organ for the mission.
John is given the task of turning a small group of Apache men into a force that can aid the U.S. Calvary.
A Native man fights prejudice to land a lucrative contract.
A gambler is determined to collect his poker winnings: half of Tombstone, Arizona.
A gold camp cook is threatened with hanging after it is discovered he was skimming nuggets from the miners.
When a horse dealer transporting a prize stallion stops in North Fork, two saddle tramps try to use trickery to obtain it.
An elderly couple moves to North Fork under an assumed name to hide the fact that they are the parents of a vicious killer. The plan backfires when the son shows up at their home.
After foiling a girl's attempt to rob the general store, Lucas finds that she and her brother are plotting the murder of their abusive stepfather.
A condemned killer being transported by train murders a marshal and takes Mark hostage.
Mark discovers that the new preacher and his wife are impostors planning a robbery.
Lucas and Marshall Torrance get into trouble with the Army when they try to help a wounded young soldier who deserted.
After Mark contracts typhoid fever and has a vision of his dead mother he no longer seems interested in getting well.
An old friend of Lucas's returns to town in the company of a shady gambler and is accused of cheating at cards.
An ex-convict is blamed for a brutal crime despite his claims of rehabilitation.
Lucas is out for vengeance when Mark is used as a pawn in a bank robbery scheme.
Lucas shoots a horse thief who turns out to be a member of the Boyle clan. Now Ma Boyle is after him.
Seven condemned murderers escape and take over the town of North Fork.
When Mark finds gold on their property, a fast-talking salesman who tried to sell Lucas a new lightning rod offers instead to buy the ranch's mineral rights.
Lucas tracks an escaped prisoner to a town that turns out to be run by the gunman's brother who is notorious for shooting people in the back.
When an outlaw leader lures Marshall Torrance out of town, Only Lucas can stop him from lynching a local man who killed one of the members of his gang.
A former army captain comes to North Fork to kill the man who shot down his son in a gunfight - Lucas McCain.
A new store owner upsets the town by demanding all credit accounts be paid off.
The widow of a bandit killed by Lucas plots a grotesque revenge.
Mark and his friend become trapped in an old mine.
Lucas and Mark attempt to reform a con-man.
Lucas encourages a drunken artist charged with murder to use his talents to identify the true killer.
Lucas and Mark try to persuade a persecuted young mute to return stolen money.
A lively old lady arrives in town hot on the trail of a notorious bandit and the reward money for capturing him.
